Try executing this chunk by clicking the *Run* button within the chunk or by placing your cursor inside it and pressing *Ctrl+Shift+Enter*. 

```{r}
#histogram of scores

library(ggplot2)

teal1 = "#e0f2f1"
teal2 = "#b2dfdb"
teal6 = "#009688"
teal8 = "#00796b"

yellow0 = "#FDF3E1"
yellow1 = "#FBE7C3"
yellow2 = "#F9DBA5"
yellow3 = "#F5C369"

library(readr)
df <- read_csv("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/PMB 122 exam 1/exam_summary.csv")

library(readxl)
PMB122_grades_total <- read_excel("Desktop/Grad/PMB 122 exam 1/PMB122_grades_total.xlsx")

library(readr)
PMB122_grades_total_gg <- read_csv("/Users/nksmoot/Desktop/Grad/PMB 122 exam 1/PMB122_grades_total_gg.csv")


df <- PMB122_grades_total_gg
head(df)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=exam_2) )+ 
  geom_histogram(bins=25, colour=teal6, fill=teal2) + 
  xlim(0, 340) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  ylab(" ") + xlab(" ") + ggtitle("Distribution of Exam 2 Scores")


p + theme_classic()

ggsave("distribution-exam2.png", width = 5, height = 4)

```

```{r}
#final grade distribution

head(df)
df$Final_Grade <- df$Final_Grade * 100

head(df)


p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=Final_Grade) )+ 
  geom_histogram(bins=20, colour=yellow3, fill=yellow1) + 
  xlim(0, 105) + 
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  ylab(" ") + xlab(" ") + ggtitle("Distribution of Final Grades")


p + theme_classic()

ggsave("final grade distribution.png", width = 5, height = 4)


```




```{r}
#violin of questions
df <- read_csv("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/PMB 122 exam 1/Exam 1 Summary.csv")
df


library(readxl)
df_2 <- read_excel("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/PMB 122 exam 1/Exam 1 Summary.xlsx")

library(readr)
question_factor <- read_csv("C:/Users/nsmoo/Desktop/PMB 122 exam 1/question_factor.csv")
head(question_factor)

question_order <- c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5", "Q6", "Q7", "Q8", "Q9", "Q10", "Q11", "Q12", "Q13", "Q14", "Q15", "Q16", "Q17", "Q18", "Q19", "Q20", "Q21", "Q22", "Q23", "Q24", "Q25", "Q26", "Q27", "Q28", "Q29", "Q30")


p <- ggplot(question_factor, aes(x=factor(question, level=question_order), y=score)) + 
  geom_violin()

p + theme_classic()

ggsave("question distribution.png", width=10, height=2)


teal1 = "#e0f2f1"
teal2 = "#b2dfdb"
teal6 = "#009688"
teal8 = "#00796b"



ggplot(question_factor, aes(x=factor(question, level=question_order), y=score)) + 
  geom_violin(color = teal6, fill = teal1)+
  theme_classic() + 
  geom_point(size=.3, color = teal8) + 
  geom_jitter(size = .3, color = teal8)  + 
  xlab("Question") + ylab("Score Distribution")


ggsave("question distribution point.png", width=10, height=2)

```
